content.description: Initial structure: 2 car archetypes, 3 motorcycle archetypes plus a custom1 space-seeking straight rider, one illegal-left box rider; early start, swarm red running, queue space seeking, box release lag, slow lane-centre rule.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant cars: M3/share/car 0.0027 and M2/early/car 0.001 are near zero, so keep impatience low; tau 1.1 and accel 2.6 target M1/car discharge headway 0.39 s.
Small group of assertive cars: shorter tau and higher accel lower M1/car headway, and lcAssertive raises wrong-lane share M8/car (0.056) while a few drive on after red for M3/per_cycle.
Typical riders filter forward: small minGapLat, lcSublane 3 and arbitrary alignment raise M4/overshoot_share (0.63) and M5/moto_density, short tau/minGap give the M1/moto headway of 0.30 s.

Aggressive riders produce red-light violations (M3/share/moto 0.092, M3/per_cycle 4.4), deeper stop-line overshoot (M4/overshoot_depth 2.0 m) and wrong-lane turns (M8/moto 0.25) via impatience, lcAssertive and lcPushy (lcPushyGap removed: SUMO ignores it when lcPushy is set).
Slow riders hold lane centre: lower speedFactor raises approach time in M6/approach moto (about 27-29 s for l/s) which a pure-speed population underestimates.
Straight riders able to seek space (custom1): needed for sidewalk (M10a 0.27/cycle), right-lane (M9a 0.33/cycle) and wrong-lane (M8/moto) behaviours, plus some red running for M3.
Illegal-left riders waiting in the box: jmTimegapMinor 1.2 s sets how tight a gap they accept after the opposing stream ends, targeting M7a/release_time 2.6 s and M7b/clear_lag 6.7 s.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto 0.13 (cars 0.001 so none applied) and M2/first_delay 2.1 s: front-row riders creep up to 8 s before green with moderate probability.
Group red running for M3/share/moto 0.092 and M3/var_to_mean 1.3 (overdispersion needs follower effect k>0); small p0 keeps the mean near 4.4 violations per cycle.
Queue triggers near the observed 13 m choice queue (M10b, M9c); probabilities follow F2 observed shares (wrong lane 0.16-0.23, right lane 0.03, sidewalk 0.016) to hit M8/moto, M9a and M10a.
Extra release hold of 1 s raises M7a/release_time (2.6 s) and M7b/clear_lag (6.7 s) towards observation without altering safety checks.
Slow riders stay at lane centre, blocking overtaking and lengthening M6/approach moto times towards 27-29 s.

reasoning: Removed lcPushyGap from moto_aggr (kept lcPushy 0.8) as SUMO ignores lcPushyGap when lcPushy is set; everything else unchanged.
